done_when: Forge no longer writes CLAUDE.md: its two Claude-only lines (story approval through Plan Mode, run long forge work in the background) move into AGENTS.md's Forge block; sync removes Forge's block from an existing CLAUDE.md and deletes the file when nothing else is left, but keeps it with an @AGENTS.md line when the repo has its own content there; doctor stops expecting CLAUDE.md; this repo's CLAUDE.md goes; tests cover the three cases

findings.body: An existing zero-byte CLAUDE.md survives sync: `_claude()` returns `""`, but the comparison at src/forge/sync.py:284 excludes it from `changed` because its current contents are also empty. The deletion branch therefore never runs. Under the stated Claude Code behavior, this file prevents automatic loading of AGENTS.md without importing it. Doctor also accepts this state because src/forge/doctor.py:98–99 uses the same content comparison. Include existing files scheduled for deletion even when their contents already equal the empty deletion sentinel.
findings.title: Delete an existing empty CLAUDE.md

why: Forge writes both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, but Claude Code (2.1.277 and later) reads AGENTS.md by itself whenever there's no CLAUDE.md, so the second file is duplication
